core_meaning.primary_meaning: Fusun is a Persian-origin name meaning “Charm, enchantment, spell”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Persian word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: No verified lexical identification was established for Fusun. Fusun is the Turkish form of the Persian feminine name افسون (Afsūn) 'charm, enchantment, spell'. The source gave فسون (which is the same word with the initial alef dropped) and the gloss 'moon, star', which is unsupported — that sense belongs to different names (e.g. Mah, Sitara). The identification as Afsun is probable. No meaning is asserted, because asserting one would require inventing evidence.
